title: Visit shapes to calculate area and perimeter
description: Circle and Rectangle implement Shape, which has an accept(ShapeVisitor) method. ShapeVisitor has visitCircle() and visitRectangle() methods. AreaVisitor and PerimeterVisitor each implement ShapeVisitor and compute their respective values. Implement both visitors and the accept() methods on each shape.
hints: accept() calls the matching visit method on the visitor: circle.accept(v) calls v.visitCircle(this)
issues: Without the Visitor pattern, adding a new operation (e.g. perimeter) requires modifying every shape class
Operations that span multiple shape types are scattered rather than grouped by concern
overallGoal: Use the Visitor pattern to add area and perimeter calculations to shapes without modifying the shape classes.
goals: Define a ShapeVisitor interface with a visit() method overload for each shape type
Add an accept(ShapeVisitor) method to each shape that calls visitor.visit(this)
Implement AreaVisitor and PerimeterVisitor, computing the correct value for circles and rectangles
